name: limit_save_onto_another_file
why: REPORT 8CD843 N55 (round 14, 27/10/2026). Whoever does not want to lose a file by mistake must be able to say so: with «overwrite» false a save onto another existing file is refused.
_what_changes_compared_to_the_twin: One argument on the third save: «overwrite» false. The same two files as the twin: each case writes its first file again before the third save, so the file is there whichever ran first.
defect_caught: That «overwrite» false is ignored and the file replaced all the same. The message must say the file exists, that nothing was saved, and how to replace it.

expect.why: the file the third save would replace
the document's own file is now the second one
